text.p: Perth-based Gilt-Edged Mining NL said on Wednesday it had started a major drilling programme at its Siberia gold project, northwest of Kalgoorlie, which is expected to lead to an early resource upgrade.

The recently-listed company, which issued its second progress report on Wednesday, said the programme would explore three sites within the Siberia project with the aim of rapidly expanding its existing gold resource.
An early resource upgrade at Siberia would make re-establishing a mining opperation within the next 18-24 months a very realistic proposition, the company said.
The interim resource estimate for Siberia is currently 2.7 million tonnes at 2.8 grams per tonne, representing 243,000 ounces of gold.
